blurb: Island Cruises Inc. offers a variety of boat cruises including scenic sunset cruises, themed party cruises, and family-friendly adventures on the waters of Carolina Beach. Cruises feature music, dancing, storytelling, and scenic views of the Atlantic Intracoastal Waterway and Cape Fear River. Special event cruises include holiday and concert-themed outings aboard the Island Explorer.
